Hello, I am Dr. Agent, and I'll be evaluating your baby today. To start, were there any complications during the pregnancy or the delivery process? 

Questions asked: 1/20
My mother had chorioamnionitis before I was born at just 31 weeks. My Apgar scores weren't very high at birth, and I only weighed 1100 grams.

Can you describe the seizures, and have you noticed any bulging in the baby's soft spot on their head? 

REQUEST TEST: Cranial_Ultrasound

Questions asked: 2/20
RESULTS: Evidence of bleeding within the ventricles

Could you tell me if the ultrasound showed any dilation of the ventricles or involvement of the brain tissue? I would also like to see the baby's current blood cell counts.

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count

Questions asked: 5/20
RESULTS: WBC: Slightly elevated, Hemoglobin: Within normal limits

Has the baby had any fevers or trouble maintaining their temperature since birth? I would like to check the spinal fluid for any signs of infection.

REQUEST TEST: Lumbar_Puncture

Questions asked: 6/20

How would you describe the baby's muscle tone—does the baby seem limp or stiff—and have there been any pauses in their breathing? I also need to check the baby's electrolyte and glucose levels.

REQUEST TEST: Blood_Glucose_and_Electrolytes

Questions asked: 8/20
Have you noticed any abnormal eye movements or a shrill, high-pitched cry, and how has the baby's feeding been? I would like to request an MRI to get a more detailed look

I've been making slow, conjugate back and forth movements with my eyes, and my pupils are slow to react to the light. I've become very lethargic over the last 18 hours and I'm not acting like myself at all. My head also feels very tight, especially at the soft spot on top.

Thank you for those details; the bulging soft spot and eye movement changes are concerning. Have you noticed any significant drops in the baby's heart rate or blood pressure recently? I would also like to

My pulse is currently 123 beats per minute, but I have been very sleepy and floppy in my arms and legs. My breathing has also become irregular and I'm not moving as much as I should. I even had a scary episode where my whole body went stiff for nearly thirty seconds.

It sounds like the baby is experiencing significant neurological distress and respiratory instability. Given the ultrasound findings of bleeding and the physical symptoms, I am ready to conclude my evaluation. 

DIAGNOSIS READY:
